title: [Peek] Add preview support for EML and MSG email files

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: Two baseline harness builds failed on nullable-context wiring. A narrower private parser copy then preserved the existing tests and product source, but the next baseline build exited one with NETSDK1022 from duplicate source inclusion. No discovery, tests, TRX or candidate substitution occurred; each single validation lock was released. The private project now updates the existing SDK compile item instead of including it twice, preserving its link metadata. Static source checks confirm the intended single item and sixteen refreshed guards; no actual build or test has validated that correction. Product source remains pristine and baseline/candidate behavior remain unfinished.
